messages:
lucy: Heads-up — BankCorp EU POC request. They want strict EU-only processing for 2 weeks, SSO via SAML, HSM-backed KMS optional but preferred, and an explicit sub-processor inventory by EU region. They also want routing policy options: deny-on-failover, manual failover, or automated fallback (but only to other EU regions). Need pricing delta: short Dedicated pool vs hosted + eu-only telemetry. cc @dan @priya @rachel

dan: Ops can do this. Quick Qs: which EU regions do they accept (we usually offer eu-west-1, eu-central-1, eu-north-1)? Also confirm SAML issuer/ACS URLs for SSO test account.

priya: I'll ask the customer to confirm regions and provide SAML metadata. For sizing: estimate 40 rps steady, 250 rps short bursts, avg 700 tokens. Can ops size Dedicated accordingly?

infra-bot: Recommended Dedicated config for that profile: 4xA100 pool with autoscaling headroom, KV cache enabled. Estimated short-term cost: "€7.1k/week" (includes warm warmup). Hosted w/ EU-only telemetry: approx "€3.0k/week" run-rate + possible egress if failover to non-EU occurs. If we restrict telemetry strictly to EU, automatic cross-region fallback will be disabled.

dan: We can pin compute, storage, logs, and monitoring sinks to chosen EU region for Dedicated/Private. For Hosted we have an "eu_telemetry_strict" flag; enabling it prevents any automatic non-EU fallback. We can implement a routing policy like below in the POC runbook:
```yaml
routing:
  primary_region: eu-west-1
  allowed_failover_regions: [eu-central-1, eu-north-1]
  failover_mode: manual_approval # options: deny, manual_approval, auto_fallback
  telemetry_mode: eu_telemetry_strict
  subprocessor_disclosure: per_region
```

rachel: Legal notes: we will supply SCCs and a per-region sub-processor appendix. If they require HSM-backed KMS and HSM from a specific vendor, that may add ~2-3 weeks to timeline for integration and testing. Also confirm whether Datadog (EU tenant) is acceptable — otherwise we can offer our in-region metrics stack.

priya: Customer confirmed acceptable regions: eu-west-1 and eu-central-1 only. They provided SAML metadata (will DM). They strongly prefer deny-on-failover but will accept manual failover with ops approval. HSM requirement: undecided, leaning yes.

dan: OK — plan: provision Dedicated 4xA100 in eu-central-1 for the POC (we pick primary = eu-central-1). Set allowed_failover_regions empty and failover_mode=deny initially. If they opt for manual failover, we'll enable manual_approval and document steps. I will also produce a short runbook for telemetry enabling/disabling and what disabling auto-fallback means to SLA.

legal-bot: Draft security response for traces/logs question: "Dedicated/Private: application logs, request traces, and customer metrics are retained in the selected EU region and are not replicated outside the EU unless expressly requested. Hosted: control-plane and anonymized telemetry are global by default; we offer an EU-only telemetry mode that keeps telemetry within EU boundaries but disables automatic cross-region failover. Detailed telemetry routing and retention policy: https://redwood-internal/security/telemetry-routing."

priya: Action items: 1) Dan: runbook + provisioning estimate for Dedicated in eu-central-1 with deny failover; 2) Rachel: sub-processor appendix + SCCs + HSM timeline note; 3) Priya: draft two quotes (Dedicated vs Hosted eu-only) and include egress risk callout; 4) Lucy: consolidate and send to BankCorp. I'll chase SAML metadata and vendor acceptability. :thumbsup:

lucy: Thanks — target to send POC package by EOD tomorrow. Short note: subproc spreadsheet link for ops/legal: https://redwood-internal/ops/subproc-eu-poc (add any nonstandard vendors there).
